_comment: 3D cube in the DIFFUSIVE regime, the 3D twin of slab_diffusive.json and box_diffusive.json: Sigma_t 100 over cells of width 0.1, so ten mean free paths per cell, with a scattering ratio of 0.99. This is the regime the removal + AIR composite has nothing to say about and the DSA diffusion correction does - it is the problem the 3D -precon_dsa pins are measured on. 10x10x10 keeps it CI-sized. All six faces vacuum, so the diffusion operator is nonsingular whatever the ratio.
